title: Parse a port number
hints: Order the checks: type (TypeError) -> empty (ValueError) -> digits (ValueError) -> range (ValueError). Each one returns or raises before the next runs.
bool is a subclass of int, so test isinstance(value, bool) before isinstance(value, int).
str.isdigit() rejects signs, dots and inner spaces, which is exactly the rule; f"got {text!r}" puts quotes around the text for you.
